name: python3-lxml
x-comment: EPUB metadata (formats/epub.py). The GNOME SDK has lxml but the Platform does not, so it is installed here with --ignore-installed (else pip sees the SDK's and installs nothing). Built from the PyPI sdist (its C is generated already, so no Cython) against the runtime's libxml2 and libxslt; made with flatpak-pip-generator.
